dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Trailing edge exhibits a deep concave curvature (falcate) with a smooth spline transition from the dorsal ridge toward the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Highest morphological point is classified as rounded with a medium pixel radius; lacks acute termination.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Anterior margin follows a convex contour rising at approximately 45 degrees relative to the horizontal longitudinal axis of the body.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: The fin's maximum pixel base width is roughly 1.2 times its maximum vertical pixel height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: The melon presents as a smooth, broad-radius convex arc extending from the blowhole region to the rostrum base.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, tapered rostrum with a high thickness-to-length ratio, showing a linear decrease in pixel width toward the distal tip.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: A distinct obtuse angle is visible at the transition point where the downward slope of the melon meets the horizontal plane of the rostrum.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A small notch or loss of tissue is visible on the lower third of the dorsal fin's trailing edge; multiple small white depigmented punctate marks are scattered along the lateral flank.
other_distinctive_markers: A complex network of high-contrast light caustics (refraction patterns) covers the majority of the visible dorsal and lateral surfaces.
